title: Next to, in front of, behind

sections.title: Where is it?
sections.content: You know postpositions (*mellett, előtt, mögött, között*): they come after the second place: *A templom a tér mellett van.* (The church is next to the square.) *A múzeum a park előtt van.* (in front of) *A kórház az iskola mögött van.* (behind) The place itself stays bare: no *-ban* here. New words: *tér* (square) and *templom* (church).

items.spanish: A templom a tér mellett van.
items.english: The church is next to the square.

items.spanish: A múzeum a park előtt van.
items.english: The museum is in front of the park.

items.spanish: A kórház az iskola mögött van.
items.english: The hospital is behind the school.

items.spanish: A szálloda a templom mögött van.
items.english: The hotel is behind the church.

items.spanish: A bank a bolt mellett van.
items.english: The bank is next to the shop.

sections.content: Put the postposition after the noun: *a tér mellett*. Do not add *-ban*: not *a térben mellett*.
